notes: Master Sync / Master Clock Reference Generator (video sync, timecode/PTP, and test-signal generator), not a display/switcher/etc. — mapped to category "other"/type "Other" since no closer fit exists in the taxonomy. Port list reflects the FULLY-OPTIONED unit per the official Tektronix/Telestream datasheet (base SPG8000A ships with only REF IN/LOOP, BLACK 1-3, LTC/GPI D-sub, WORD CLOCK, ETHERNET, USB and AC IN — options noted per-port add the rest): Option BG adds BLACK 4-5 + CMPST 1-2; Option SDI adds the 4 SDI BNC outputs (grade sdi-3g, the highest format the unit generates — it supports SD/HD/3G-SDI); Option AG adds 4 AES/EBU BNCs + 1 DARS BNC; Option GPS adds the GPS/GLONASS antenna BNC input; Option PTP adds a dedicated RJ45 ("Ethernet connection 1") plus an SFP cage ("Ethernet connection 2", populated via Option LX 1310nm single-mode or Option SX 850nm multimode module) — the datasheet lists these as connectors distinct from the base management Ethernet port, though it does not show a rear-panel diagram confirming physical separation. Option DPW adds a second hot-swappable power supply with its own AC inlet/cord. LTC I/O (3 dedicated outputs + LTC1 selectable in/out) and GPI (2 out/1 in) are combined on one rear D-sub 15-pin connector; no "generic D-sub-15" id exists in the allowed connector list, so "vga" (also a DB-15 shell) was chosen as the closest available shape — it is NOT a video/VGA signal. An optional accessory breakout cable (Option XLR, not itself a built-in port) splits this into 4 XLR (LTC) + 3 BNC (GPI). AC inlet type is inferred as IEC (C13/C14) per standard 1U Tektronix/Telestream rack-gear practice; the datasheet gives voltage/frequency (100-240 VAC, 50/60 Hz) and regional power-plug/cord options but does not explicitly name the inlet connector, hence medium rather than high confidence. Front-panel USB port (preset backup/restore, firmware upgrade) has no stated USB version, so grade omitted. Word clock and AES/EBU/DARS/reference-sync BNCs carry non-SDI analog/clock signals, so no sdi-* grade was applied to them (only the actual SDI outputs got sdi-3g) per the grading rule that BNC ports are graded only when they carry bandwidth-tiered signals. GPS antenna and GPS/GLONASS receiver themselves add no separate port beyond the BNC antenna input. Secondary source cross-checked: Tektronix SPG8000A User Manual (download.tek.com/manual/SPG8000A-User-Manual-077121600.pdf), which corroborates BLACK 1-5, CMPST, GPI/LTC port, and PTP/Ethernet naming but does not include machine-readable rear-panel diagram text.

ports.name: REF IN
ports.note: External genlock/reference input: NTSC/PAL black burst, HD tri-level sync, or 10 MHz CW.

ports.name: REF LOOP
ports.note: Passive (unterminated) loop-through of REF IN for daisy-chaining to another unit; must be 75-ohm terminated on the last device in the chain.

ports.name: BLACK 1
ports.note: Base configuration. Independently configurable: NTSC/PAL black burst, HD tri-level sync, or 1pps.

ports.name: BLACK 2
ports.note: Base configuration. Independently configurable: NTSC/PAL black burst, HD tri-level sync, or 1pps.

ports.name: BLACK 3
ports.note: Base configuration. Independently configurable: NTSC/PAL black burst, HD tri-level sync, 10 MHz CW, or 1pps.

ports.name: BLACK 4
ports.note: Requires Option BG. NTSC/PAL black burst or HD tri-level sync.

ports.name: BLACK 5
ports.note: Requires Option BG. NTSC/PAL black burst or HD tri-level sync.

ports.name: CMPST 1
ports.note: Requires Option BG. Independent composite analog (NTSC/PAL) test-pattern generator output.

ports.name: CMPST 2
ports.note: Requires Option BG. Independent composite analog (NTSC/PAL) test-pattern generator output.

ports.name: WORD CLOCK
ports.note: Base configuration. 48 kHz word clock, 5V DC (CMOS) or 1V AC into 75 ohm (AES level).

ports.name: SDI 1A
ports.note: Requires Option SDI. Generator channel 1, output A; configurable to any SD/HD/3G-SDI format.

ports.name: SDI 1B
ports.note: Requires Option SDI. Generator channel 1, output B (test pattern or digital black).

ports.name: SDI 2A
ports.note: Requires Option SDI. Generator channel 2, output A; configurable to any SD/HD/3G-SDI format.

ports.name: SDI 2B
ports.note: Requires Option SDI. Generator channel 2, output B (test pattern or digital black).

ports.name: AES 1
ports.note: Requires Option AG. AES3-format (AES/EBU) test-tone pair, 75-ohm unbalanced BNC.

ports.name: AES 2
ports.note: Requires Option AG. AES3-format (AES/EBU) test-tone pair, 75-ohm unbalanced BNC.

ports.name: AES 3
ports.note: Requires Option AG. AES3-format (AES/EBU) test-tone pair, 75-ohm unbalanced BNC.

ports.name: AES 4
ports.note: Requires Option AG. AES3-format (AES/EBU) test-tone pair, 75-ohm unbalanced BNC.

ports.name: DARS
ports.note: Requires Option AG. Digital Audio Reference Signal (AES3-format), 75-ohm unbalanced BNC.

ports.name: GPS ANT
ports.note: Requires Option GPS. 50-ohm, internally terminated GPS/GLONASS L1 antenna input; supplies 3.3V or 5V DC (55 mA) to power an active antenna (e.g. SPG8000ANT, which itself uses an F-type connector).

ports.name: LTC/GPI (D-Sub 15)
ports.note: Generic 15-pin D-sub, NOT a video/VGA signal — closest available connector id chosen for its DB-15 shell shape. Carries 3 dedicated LTC outputs + 1 LTC input/output, plus 2 GPI outputs + 1 GPI input. An optional accessory breakout cable (Option XLR) splits this to 4 male XLR (LTC) + 3 male BNC (GPI).

ports.name: ETHERNET
ports.note: Base configuration. 10/100/1000BASE-T for web UI remote configuration, SNMPv2 management, and NTP server (with Option GPS).

ports.name: Ethernet connection 1 (PTP)
ports.note: Requires Option PTP. RJ45 8P8C, 10/100/1000BASE-T, listed in the datasheet as a connector distinct from the base management ETHERNET port.

ports.name: Ethernet connection 2 (PTP SFP)
ports.note: Requires Option PTP plus an SFP module (Option LX: 1310nm single-mode LC, or Option SX: 850nm multimode LC). MSA-standard 1 Gigabit Ethernet SFP cage.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Front-panel USB port for backing up/restoring presets and user data, and performing firmware upgrades. USB version not stated in the datasheet.

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Primary hot-swappable power supply module inlet, 100-240 VAC 50/60Hz, 130VA max. Connector type (IEC C13/C14) inferred from standard rack-gear practice; not explicitly named in the datasheet.

ports.name: AC IN 2
ports.note: Requires Option DPW (second hot-swappable redundant power supply module with its own power cord). Connector type inferred as IEC, same caveat as AC IN.
